proposed_title: Chat fine-tuning changes first-turn and history readouts differently
chart: checkpoint lines in separate readout panels
denominator: First-turn supplied-tangent rates use 256 replies/checkpoint; story enactment uses 256 cuts. History cells use their stored reply counts; history gaps use paired scripts.
uncertainty: Stored 95% intervals. First-turn checkpoint extension was a post-hoc amendment; do not merge independent reference reruns.
caveats: First-turn habit suppression is not erasure of the story association. The dismissive update can make rival selection high after either prior history, while story enactment declines.
